bridges.name: Potter Heigham (Old Road Bridge)
bridges.notes: Pilot mandatory (Phoenix Fleet, 01692 670460, ~£10). Low semicircular arch with steeply falling sides — effectively impassable for standard cruisers (0 boats through in 2024). Cross only near low water with the pilot.

bridges.name: Wroxham (Road Bridge)
bridges.notes: Pilot mandatory for hire craft (07775 297 638, ~£15 return). 1619 arch, strong currents; height + tide affected.

bridges.name: Wroxham Railway Bridge
bridges.notes: High — not a constraint for hire craft. Listed for completeness.

bridges.name: Great Yarmouth (Vauxhall / old rail)
bridges.notes: Lowest of the Yarmouth pair on the Breydon transit. Cross near low water (slack, ~1 h after LW at Yarmouth).

bridges.name: Great Yarmouth (Acle New Road)
bridges.notes: On the Breydon transit; tide-dependent. Time the crossing with the Yarmouth tide.

bridges.name: Breydon Bridge
bridges.notes: Fixed span ~3.96 m; lifting span ~3.5 m (opens on request). Use the right-hand span between the two arrows. On the Breydon tidal crossing.

bridges.name: Beccles (Old Road Bridge)
bridges.notes: Tied lowest arched road bridge. No pilot but care required; gives access to upper Beccles/Geldeston. The bypass road bridge alongside is ~4.27 m.

bridges.name: Ludham Bridge
bridges.notes: Tide-affected; pass with the canopy down. No pilot.

bridges.name: Wayford Bridge
bridges.notes: Head of navigation on the River Ant; tide-affected.

bridges.name: Acle Bridge
bridges.notes: Tide-affected. A constraint only for the tallest craft.

bridges.name: Reedham Swing Bridge
bridges.notes: Rail swing bridge — opens on request (3 long horn blasts / VHF Ch 12 / 0330 858 4655). 1 red flag = operational, 2 = out of service.

bridges.name: Somerleyton Swing Bridge
bridges.notes: Rail swing bridge — opens on request (3 long blasts / VHF Ch 12).

bridges.name: Thorpe Railway Bridges (Norwich)
bridges.notes: Very low (~6 ft) — on the short Whitlingham dead-end above Norwich; not on the main route to Norwich Yacht Station.

lock.name: Mutford Lock (Oulton Broad)
lock.notes: The only lock on the Broads — the gateway from Oulton Broad to Lake Lothing and the sea. The Mutford road bridge alongside is ~2.40 m.

zones.notes: Breydon Water — Tidal crossing linking the Northern & Southern Broads. Cross at slack water (~1 h after low water at Great Yarmouth). Keep strictly inside the red & green posts ("Up, Red, Right"). Last safe moorings ~4 mi out at Berney Arms / Burgh Castle. Do NOT approach Haven Bridge.
Hoveton Great Broad — Conservation broad — no powered navigation. Nature trail accessible by dinghy only.
Cockshoot Broad — Conservation broad — closed to navigation; boardwalk & hide reached on foot from Cockshoot Dyke moorings.
Upton Broad — Private conservation broad — no navigation.
